# Jeremiah 52 — Disagreement Log

## 52:13 (overlap: 6%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-he-burned the-house-of YHWH and-the-house-of the-king, and-all the-houses-of Jerusalem and-every great house he-burned with-fire. |
| LOGOS | And he burned the house of the LORD, and the king's house, and all the houses of Jerusalem; every great house he burned down. |
| PNEUMA | He burned the LORD's Temple to the ground, along with the royal palace and every important building in Jerusalem. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
